name: Flauntopia
author: flauntopia

sections.description:
Flauntopia is a tool designed for individual bloggers who want to display beautifully designed product boxes inside their blog posts — without coding or designing anything manually.

This WordPress plugin acts as a small connector between your website and the Flauntopia website, enabling your blog to display product boxes using the embed script.

🎯 What Flauntopia Does

  • Helps you create stunning product boxes.
  • Provides multiple ready-made templates.
  • Lets you customize design, add animation, customize its speed and timing.
  • Generates an embed code that you paste inside blog posts.
  • Updates your product boxes everywhere automatically when you edit them on Flauntopia.

🧩 Types of Boxes You Can Create

  • Single product box
  • Top 3 products box
  • VS comparison box
  • Pros & cons box

🔗 This Plugin Includes:

  • A built-in script injector to load the Flauntopia embed script into your footer.
  • A beautiful, guided Flauntopia Dashboard inside WordPress admin with:
    • How-to instructions
    • Buttons to create new product boxes
    • Helpful links and documentation
    • Explanation of the whole system

🚀 How It Works

  1. Install & activate this plugin.
  2. Visit the new Flauntopia menu inside your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Create product boxes from the external Flauntopia website.
  4. Copy the embed code from Flauntopia.
  5. Paste it anywhere inside your blog post.
  6. The box instantly appears on your site (live).
  7. Update the box anytime in Flauntopia — it auto-updates everywhere on your blog.

This plugin does not store data and does not create tables in your database. It simply loads the Flauntopia public script and gives you a smooth admin experience.

  • This plugin does not create custom database tables in your WordPress site.
  • This plugin does not store product box data in your WordPress database.
  • All product box data is stored in your Flauntopia account on our servers (flauntopia.com).
  • The plugin send information to flauntopia such as:
    • Your site URL (on plugin activation and deactivation)
    • Plugin version (on plugin activation and deactivation)
    • WordPress Version (on plugin activation and deactivation)
    • Requests needed to render product boxes

For more information, please see our Privacy Policy and terms and conditions. And if you have any doubts, confusion then please feel free to contact us.

Privacy Policy: https://www.flauntopia.com/blog/blog/privacy-policy
Terms and conditions: https://www.flauntopia.com/blog/blog/terms-and-conditions
Contact us: https://www.flauntopia.com/blog/blog/contact-us
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP or install directly from WordPress.org.
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. A new menu called Flauntopia will appear in your Dashboard.
  5. Open it to access the Flauntopia guide and external tool links.
  6. Create product boxes from the main Flauntopia website.
  7. Paste the generated embed code inside your blog posts.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin create product boxes inside WordPress?

No. The actual creation of product boxes happens on the external Flauntopia web app.
This plugin simply loads the Flauntopia embed script and gives you a dashboard UI inside WordPress.

Does the plugin work without an account on Flauntopia?

You can install the plugin, but you’ll need a Flauntopia account to generate and manage your product boxes.

Will my existing product boxes update automatically?

Yes. When you edit or update a product box inside Flauntopia, it automatically updates everywhere you’ve pasted the code on your blog.

Does this plugin add any database tables?

No, it does not alter your database.
It only adds a menu page and inserts one script into the footer.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, the plugin is free. Flauntopia (the external tool) may offer free and paid plans for creating product boxes.

Does it slow down my website?

No. The Flauntopia script is lightweight and loaded in the footer using the defer attribute.
